lines: It must be okay to be foolish, the dream's marks that spread before us.
Farewell, azure days.
I let the current carry me, someday becoming an adult.
Is it that we become a little dirtier each day?
Only the ripe fruits are chosen.
Before being torn by a knife and swallowed.
We aimed for Shangri‑La.
Desire cannot be restrained.
We kept yearning for a “freedom” drenched in fantasy.
Now I can say this is indeed paradise.
Farewell, azure days.
Even if it means using something precious as a stepping stone.
I wanted to grab the highest apple.
The precious thing we realize only after losing it.
We, as children, were full of missed targets.
The conquest of contented days
makes us emotionally unstable.
I wish to soar even if it means getting wounded.
It must be okay to be foolish, the dream's marks that spread before us.
Farewell, azure days.
The shining sky pretends innocence.
It knew everything...
We aimed for Shangri‑La.
Desire cannot be restrained.
We kept yearning for a “freedom” drenched in fantasy.
Only by keeping distance do we learn our own magnitude.
An immature heart remains unaware of even that.
Now I can say this is indeed paradise.
Farewell, azure days.
